localOnly: This branch was created locally and never pushed. The repository is public, so review before any push.

base.why: The branch starts at the canonical HEAD, so the six HEAD-only commits that are not patch-equivalent on origin/main stay reachable from this branch as well.

includeRule.included: tracked unshipped or conflicting files and untracked files that are absent from origin/main or differ from it, copied byte for byte from the dirty checkout
includeRule.excludedRedundant: tracked identical or superseded files and untracked identical files, whose content already exists on origin/main; their exact local bytes are identified by canonicalBlob and sha256 only
includeRule.excludedPrivate: docs/writing-drafts/** is never committed; those six entries keep hashes but their file names are redacted (pathSha256 is sha256 of the original repo-relative path)

notes.lockfilePatchCoupling: pnpm-lock.yaml here is the local version, which records the local patches/@astryxdesign__core@0.4.6.patch hash 1cd08a3f. That patch was excluded as superseded, so this branch carries HEAD's patch (hash 373d44ef) and pnpm install with a frozen lockfile fails on this branch with ERR_PNPM_LOCKFILE_CONFIG_MISMATCH. Regenerate the lockfile after rebasing onto origin/main instead of trusting it.
notes.supersededAgainstMainOnly: Excluded superseded files are redundant with origin/main, not with HEAD. On this HEAD-based branch those paths still show HEAD content; take them from origin/main when restoring.
notes.ignoredFileNotPreserved: docs/design/admin-workspace/vision-2026-09-13/playground.html is ignored by .gitignore (playground*.html) and is not in this branch, although the included playground-README.md refers to it.
notes.stashes: The two pre-existing stashes in the shared repository were left untouched.
notes.exactBytes: Included files whose committed blob differs from canonicalBlob (for example after the pre-commit formatter) are listed in reformatted, with their exact canonical bytes in .preservation/exact-bytes.tar.gz.

restore.step1: In the codex/document-editor checkout, run git status and commit or otherwise save any newer work first. Do not reset, clean or check out over it.
restore.step2: If a dirty file still exists there, compare its sha256 with this manifest. A match means nothing needs restoring for that path.
restore.step3: Create the patch: git diff --binary e58fa668c4a792017f8319b1aff7545c8cf7bc05 preserve/codex-document-editor-2026-09-14 > /tmp/codex-preserve.diff
restore.step4: Apply it onto the current branch with a three-way merge so newer commits are merged rather than overwritten: git apply --3way --exclude='.preservation/*' /tmp/codex-preserve.diff . Resolve any conflict markers by hand.
restore.step5: For every path in reformatted, replace the working copy with the exact bytes from .preservation/exact-bytes.tar.gz (extract to a temp directory, verify sha256, then copy).
restore.step6: Bring in excluded redundant files by rebasing or merging origin/main, then regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml with pnpm install.
